download_atlas_model: run the script to download a pretrained Atlas model by name to a specified output directory
download_atlas_model_cli: run the CLI with --model and --output_directory flags to download an Atlas model checkpoint
list_available_atlas_models: run the script with --help to list all available Atlas pretrained and finetuned models
download_atlas_nq_model: run the script to download an Atlas model finetuned on Natural Questions to a local directory
download_atlas_model_main: call main with an output directory and model name to download the model.pth.tar checkpoint
